purpose: Final Layer 3 visual and accessibility verification at both supported widths (AC-11, AC-13; RF-2.1, RF-2.2, RF-4, RF-12, RF-14; RNF-4, RNF-5).
tool: Chrome DevTools MCP (real CDP): emulate, navigate_page (fresh GET), take_snapshot (verbose), evaluate_script, fill_form, click, press_key, list_network_requests, list_console_messages

screenshots.capture: fullPage PNG of a fresh GET default (student) state; distinct from baseline-*.png and layer3-error-*.png

figma_reference.reason: No Figma file key is available in the repository. AGENTS.md treats Figma as a visual reference rather than a strict technical specification; the approved T1.1 baseline screenshots (evidence/baseline-1440.png, evidence/baseline-402.png) were used as the concrete visual comparison reference. This limitation was recorded, not treated as a blocker.

error_text_contrast.note: Identical computation at both widths because the computed color is the same; WCAG sRGB linearization (0.03928 / 0.055 / 2.4) with 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722 weights.

server_error_method.description: Native form POST with JavaScript enabled. The email 'usu..ario@example.com' is accepted by the permissive shared ASCII email pattern in js/features/register-validation.js (client reported zero errors) but rejected by PHP FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL, so a real server-generated field error is re-rendered at HTTP 200. No JavaScript disabling was used.
server_error_method.db_inspect_result: NOT FOUND: no account matches correo = usu..ario@example.com (exit 0) at both widths

observations: Chrome's accessibility tree represents the unchecked, required terms checkbox as invalid="true" on the fresh GET; the DOM has no aria-invalid attribute (verified: getAttribute('aria-invalid') === null, required=true, aria-required='true'). This is the browser's inferred representation of an unsatisfied required control, not a server/client validation error. With terms checked after the server re-render the tree shows 'checked'.

An initial navigation with ignoreCache:true caused the browser to request /favicon.ico (404), which appeared as a console error. A plain fresh GET (the specified procedure) produced no favicon request and '<no console messages found>' at both widths. The favicon 404 is a pre-existing site-wide missing asset, unrelated to the registration page JavaScript.

page_geometry.scroll_reachability: At max scroll (scrollY=303 of 303) the Confirmar contraseña control, terms checkbox and Crear Cuenta submit are fully inside the viewport.

Visible focus indicators (3px solid outline) on role button and invalid control
Error text rgb(179,38,30), opacity 1, 14px desktop / 12px mobile, contrast 6.5365:1 >= 4.5:1
Simulated long error wraps inside the card with no horizontal overflow; real server state restored
Meta description exactly 'Regístrate en ProfeGo como estudiante o docente.'
